report_claims.claim_text: By mid-2026, the S&P 500 Shiller CAPE ratio climbed to 41.18; the report compares this with the 44.2 peak of the December 1999 dot-com bubble.
report_claims.qualifier: CAPE is a long-horizon index valuation measure, not a single-stock multiple.

report_claims.claim_text: SK hynix and Micron have traded at forward P/E ratios ranging between 4× and 7×.
report_claims.qualifier: The report presents this as a valuation comparison; memory earnings remain cyclical.

report_claims.claim_text: In 2025, the top ten stocks represented roughly 41% of the S&P 500's total weight.
report_claims.qualifier: The report uses roughly 41% for the 2025 expected-weight comparison.

report_claims.claim_text: In 2025, the top ten stocks were expected to generate roughly 32% of aggregate S&P 500 earnings.
report_claims.qualifier: This is an expected aggregate earnings contribution, not a claim about every constituent.

report_claims.claim_text: The report says passive-indexing inflows systematically direct forty dollars of every one hundred invested dollars into the top ten companies.
report_claims.qualifier: The report presents this as a feedback-loop mechanism supporting index weights.

report_claims.claim_text: Samsung Electronics, SK hynix, and Micron Technology control the critical memory bottleneck described by the report.
report_claims.qualifier: The report calls the structure a highly consolidated oligopoly; it also documents emerging challengers elsewhere in memory.

report_claims.claim_text: The mid-1980s DRAM market had more than thirty active manufacturers; price wars, capital requirements, and technology transitions drove almost every player into bankruptcy or forced mergers.
report_claims.qualifier: The report's historical consolidation thesis is the setup for the triopoly argument.

report_claims.claim_text: Producing a single bit of HBM consumes roughly three times the wafer capacity required to produce a single bit of standard DDR5.
report_claims.qualifier: This is the report's physical capacity-penalty mechanism, not a claim about a stock's fair value.

report_claims.claim_text: The report concludes that the three dominant memory manufacturers remain structurally undervalued relative to their role as AI-infrastructure enablers.
report_claims.qualifier: This is the report's investment thesis and is presented as such.
